protocol.profiled_launch_rationale: Hardware byte counters are collected for one post-warmup launch per formal case. Performance p50/IQR remain the frozen OP2 200-repetition interleaved CUDA-event results; ncu replay duration is not used as timing.
protocol.outside_tolerance_rule: Use measured dram__bytes.sum as the authoritative per-case byte account without changing the immutable OP2 artifact.
protocol.cache_control_meaning: Nsight Compute flushes all GPU caches before each profiled replay pass.
protocol.profile_control: --profile-from-start off plus cudaProfilerStart/Stop around exactly the 96 formal launches

projected_workload.accounting_rule: analytic when within ±15%; otherwise per-case ncu measured bytes

interpretation.ncu_duration_use: diagnostic only; excluded from throughput and roofline timing
interpretation.counter_repetitions: one profiled launch per formal case after 50 warmups; Nsight kernel replay collected the requested deterministic counters
interpretation.disagreement_policy: A >15% difference does not fail OP4; it makes the measured ncu byte count authoritative for that case.

accounting_effect.op4_tier_b_status: authoritative correction layer for cases outside ±15%
accounting_effect.consumer_rule: Use formal_case_measurements[].accounting_bytes and aggregate.projected_workload.accounting_bytes for post-OP4 K1 roofline reporting.
